up: Retrieve compound structures for molecules tested against the human survival motor neuron protein (CHEMBL1293232). Return: compound CHEMBL identifier (CHEMBL_ID), preferred molecule name (PREF_NAME), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Ensure compounds have at least one activity record linked to an assay where the target chemistry is CHEMBL1293232 (target_chembl_id). Use INNER JOIN on activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures to confirm activity against the specified target. Do not filter by activity type, standard values, or other assay parameters unless specified.
sql:
WITH target_compounds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293232'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS molecule_pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM target_compounds tc
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON tc.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno;
